acceptance.source_defaults_frames: sample_rate + 512 (at least two default 2 Hz trigger events)
acceptance.uniform_policy: Identical explicitly supplied f32 stream per frame, consumed only by the unchanged source call sites and the production Rust function. At most two draws: probability only when probability < 1; target only after acceptance with disconnected external voltage. No claim of parity with Rack's uncontrolled global PRNG.
acceptance.lifecycle: Event 1 is source/host Initialize: apply source parameter defaults while retaining runtime. Event 2 constructs a fresh identity with fresh runtime. Event 3 and ordinary parameter changes retain runtime through production adopt. Source has no custom onReset override.
acceptance.source_input_boundary: Rack cable bookkeeping zeroes all input slots at and above width, including slot zero of a disconnected port. The genuine class reads raw getVoltage(0); production receives poisoned inactive padding and must supply the equivalent zero boundary.
acceptance.excluded_source_paths: Nonfinite values and computed internal rate outside [-120,120] are rejected by fixtures and adapter. Rack scalar exp2Floor uses float-to-int and signed shifts and has no defined arbitrary-input contract. The finite suite never reaches those paths. Shape zero's IEEE float division is defined and is included.
acceptance.rationale: 20 microvolts plus 2 ppm bounds source libm interpolation rounding; phase and light budgets are 2 micro-units. Timer and pulse budgets are tight absolute f32 budgets. Exact clock/acceptance events, draw counts, Schmitt state and widths prevent voltage tolerance from hiding clock or lifecycle errors. No per-case relaxation, warmup, alignment, frame-count override or partial-suite qualification.

method: Actual pinned Random class compiled in an owned build directory against installed Rack SDK. Only plugin include and widget/registration suffix removed, and the two uniform call sites redirected to an explicitly supplied identical f32 draw stream. The Rust example calls production RandomProbe step_with_uniform and production parameter adoption. Full suite, frame zero, all five outputs and all sixteen storage lanes, all held lanes and shared clock/timer/Schmitt/pulse/light state. No native global PRNG sequence claim.
limitations: Finite synthetic digital coverage only; no GUI, hardware, audio device, acoustic, latency or performance claim
The production example executable is built separately; its exact binary and complete local source closure are hashed
Source host-input bookkeeping zeroes missing lanes; poisoned padding is delivered only to production host PortFrame
Public Engine cables, callback partitioning, bypass, persistence and graph replacement require separate host integration tests

trace_retention.format: One deterministic gzip per input/SDK/Rust trace; raw SHA256 and gzip SHA256 recorded per case

path_normalization: Absolute machine paths use $REPO_ROOT, $RACK_SDK and $MACOS_SDK. Numerical results, hashes and relative artifact paths are unchanged; the exact local report hash is retained.
